instructions: Keep the id on every opportunity that is already in the portal; change only the fields that need updating.
Add new opportunities as new objects WITHOUT an id. An item without an id whose name matches an existing one updates that one instead of being added twice.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD or null. deadline drives the reminder emails; put fuzzy dates like "~Feb 2027" in deadline_text.
category, kind and status must be one of the listed values. suggested_members is a list of names.
Do not change updated_at: it lets the portal spot items edited by someone else after this export.
